import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    n = int(input_data[0].strip())
    s = input_data[1].strip() if len(input_data) > 1 else ""
    
    data = list(s)
    
    maxOut = 0
    maxIn = 0
    length = 0
    inside = False
    
    for ch in data:
        if ch == '(':
            if length > 0:
                maxOut = max(maxOut, length)
            length = 0
            inside = True
        elif ch == ')':
            if length > 0:
                maxIn += 1
            length = 0
            inside = False
        elif ch == '_':
            if inside:
                if length > 0:
                    maxIn += 1
                length = 0
            else:
                if length > 0:
                    maxOut = max(maxOut, length)
                length = 0
        else:
            length += 1
    
    if length > 0:
        maxOut = max(maxOut, length)
    
    print(f"{maxOut} {maxIn}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
